message.monstergirls.merge_trust: %s and %s would flow together, but both need high friendship with you first

message.monstergirls.heart_heavy: %s weighs your heart against the feather. It is heavy with blood: she will hunt you
message.monstergirls.anubis_guard: %s bars the way: the tomb is not yours to open
message.monstergirls.lich_freed: Her phylactery is broken: %s is free
bond.monstergirls.zhuque.shy: watches you from a ring of heat (%s)
bond.monstergirls.zhuque.friend: brings summer wherever you walk together (%s)
advancement.monstergirls.four_symbols.de: Befriend the guardians of the four quarters: the Azure Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird and the Black Tortoise
message.monstergirls.kobold_ore: %s sniffs and points: %s, about %s blocks away
message.monstergirls.kobold_cave_in: %s yelps: the ceiling there is loose!
message.monstergirls.ratatoskr_takes: %s tucks it into her satchel and dashes off to %s
message.monstergirls.ratatoskr_nobody: %s has nobody else to take it to
message.monstergirls.ratatoskr_prank: %s brings you a delivery from %s... or something like it

message.monstergirls.leshy_fog: %s's fog closes around you. You are lost in his forest
message.monstergirls.llorona_home: %s stops weeping: the lost one is home
message.monstergirls.ahuizotl_steal: %s's tail-hand snatches the fish off your line!
advancement.monstergirls.why.desc: Catch a firefly or a fairy in a jar

message.monstergirls.drop_bear: %s drops on you out of the tree!
message.monstergirls.drop_bear_hug: %s drops out of the tree to hug you
message.monstergirls.mummy_flustered: %s goes red and spins herself back up in her bandages
message.monstergirls.mummy_guard: %s stands in front of the tomb's treasure
bond.monstergirls.flamingo.shy: lifts one leg and eyes you (%s)

message.monstergirls.oni_beans: "Oni wa soto!" %s flees from the beans
message.monstergirls.siren_song: %s's song draws you toward the water
message.monstergirls.boots_swapped: %s swapped your boots for leather ones! Feed her to get yours back
bond.monstergirls.magpie.curious: wonders what you have that shines (%s)
bond.monstergirls.raven.curious: says your name in your own voice (%s)
bond.monstergirls.raven.friend: keeps the monsters guessing for you (%s)
message.monstergirls.clock_phantoms: %s's watch tolls: you have not slept in three nights, and the phantoms know it
message.monstergirls.rook_cure: %s goes to cure the zombie villager
message.monstergirls.mail_parcel: %s takes the %s. Now a paper with a player's name on it
riddle.monstergirls.0: I have hands but cannot clap, a face but cannot smile, and I am never late. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.1: I point one way whatever way you turn me. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.2: Full of holes, yet I hold water. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.3: Strike me and I sing; I have keys but open no locks. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.4: I have a neck but no head, and I am empty until you fill me. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.5: Give me air and I live; give me water and I die. Hold me and I light your way. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.6: I have a tongue but cannot speak, and I call the village to me. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.7: I have leaves but am no tree, a spine but am no beast. What am I?
riddle.monstergirls.8: Carry me and you carry a lake; pour me and I am gone. What am I?
message.monstergirls.anvil_no_material: %s has nothing to mend it with: bring its repair material
message.monstergirls.sphinx_right: %s purrs: right! She gives you a prize
message.monstergirls.silkcoon_water: %s needs water nearby to wash it

bond.monstergirls.pumpkingull.curious: peers at you from under her pumpkin (%s)
bond.monstergirls.pumpkingull.friend: grins as wide as her pumpkin (%s)
bond.monstergirls.condorune.curious: lands a little way off and watches you (%s)
bond.monstergirls.condorune.friend: keeps an eye on you from the updrafts (%s)
bond.monstergirls.mirror_crane.curious: tilts her head and watches you from one leg (%s)
bond.monstergirls.mirror_crane.friend: spreads her bright wings between you and danger (%s)
message.monstergirls.valkyrie.gathered: %s gathers up everything you left where you fell. Come back to her for it.
message.monstergirls.valkyrie.returned: %s gives you back what you lost
message.monstergirls.armed: %s takes the weapon. She'll use it on your enemies
item.monstergirls.harmontide_journal.des: Every creature you have met, and the ones you have befriended.
journal.monstergirls.serval_nekomata.sig: Sky pounce & ear scan: Leaps three blocks up to catch birds and bats in mid-air. A bonded serval hears what you cannot: she hisses and flattens her ears towards the nearest hostile mob within 24 blocks, even through stone.
journal.monstergirls.tiger_nekomata.sign: Ambush, fishing & roar: Crouched in bamboo or tall grass she is nearly invisible until she pounces (a strong opening strike). She catches fish in rivers and brings them to her favourites. Her roar makes hostile mobs within 12 blocks flee for a few seconds.
journal.monstergirls.lioness_nekomata.si: Pride: A bonded lioness treats you as part of her pride: when you attack something, every lioness of her pride within 24 blocks joins in, and when you are hurt they come running.
journal.monstergirls.snow_leopard_nekoma: Cliff leaps & warm tail: She jumps across gaps up to six blocks and never takes fall damage. A bonded snow leopard near you stops you freezing in powder snow; asleep beside you she wraps you in her tail (no freezing, Resistance I when you wake).
journal.monstergirls.cheetah_nekomata.si: Sprint bursts & pace-setter: Five-second bursts at double speed (then a rest). Sprint alongside a bonded cheetah and she paces you: you get Speed II while she runs. She hunts rabbits for you and drops them at your feet.
journal.monstergirls.lynx_nekomata.signa: Snowshoe paws & rabbit hunter: She never sinks into powder snow and moves at full speed on snow. She keeps rabbits away from your crops and brings you rabbit hide and rabbit's feet. Watched for too long, she slips out of sight (she breaks line of sight and hides).
journal.monstergirls.ocelot_nekomata.sig: Tree climber: She climbs straight up tree trunks and walls like the gray fox and spends the day high in the canopy. Her presents are jungle finds: cocoa beans, feathers, the odd melon slice.
Burning paws: Fireproof. Her blows set things alight, and she lights campfires and candles near her. Blazes are her kin; befriended, her friend takes no harm from fire beside her.
journal.monstergirls.waterlil_nekomata.s: Lily pads: Lily pads grow under her as she walks on water, and fade again behind her; befriended, they grow under her friend too while they are near her.
journal.monstergirls.cheshire_nekomata.s: The grin: Unless you look straight at her she fades away, all but her glowing grin; befriended, she blinks back to her friend's side whenever she is left behind.
Snow strider: She walks on powder snow and never freezes; her friend gets Speed while on snow.
journal.monstergirls.jaglare_nekomata.si: Ambush: She lurks in the jungle trees and drops on what passes below. Her roar weakens monsters near her friend.
Fairy cat: Phantoms keep away from her friend. A saucer of milk (a milk bucket) brings her friend Luck for five minutes.
journal.monstergirls.bakeneko_nekomata.s: Ghost lights: At night her wisps light up the ground around her friend.
journal.monstergirls.censer_lion_nekomat: Incense: Befriended, her friend near her sleeps soundly in her incense, so no phantoms come for them, and phantoms already hunting her friend lose interest.
journal.monstergirls.red_kitsune.signatu: Master of illusions: Her decoy lasts longer and she can leave two. At three tails she plays the stash game with you on purpose: she hides a small present (an emerald, a gold nugget, sweet berries) instead of stealing.
journal.monstergirls.arctic_kitsune.sign: Snow dive & cold-proof: Never freezes, walks on powder snow, and dives into snow blocks to catch hidden prey (rabbits, silverfish). A bonded arctic fox curled in your bed keeps you from freezing all night.
journal.monstergirls.fennec_kitsune.sign: Desert digger: She digs fast in sand and sometimes turns things up: bones, gold nuggets, pottery sherds, an occasional emerald. A bonded fennec digs for you and brings what she finds.
journal.monstergirls.corsac_kitsune.sign: Wayfinder: A bonded corsac always knows the way home: at night, when you are more than 64 blocks from your bed, she trots towards it and waits for you, leaving a trail of foxfire.
journal.monstergirls.gray_kitsune.signat: Tree climber: She climbs logs and leaves like a ladder, perches in the canopy and drops onto prey (or onto zombies threatening her bonded player).
journal.monstergirls.wattlefox_kitsune.s: After the fire: She cannot burn. Befriended, she puts out fires near her friend and plants acacia saplings on bare ground.
journal.monstergirls.vulphea_kitsune.sig: Rebirth: She cannot burn and her bite sets things alight. Once a day, a killing blow leaves only ashes, and a minute later she rises from them.
journal.monstergirls.huli_jing_kitsune.s: Charm: In a village with her friend the villagers trade cheaper: her friend has Hero of the Village while near her.
Desert guide: Her friend near her runs fast on sand (Speed II), and husks near her lose interest in her friend.
journal.monstergirls.python_lamia.signat: Coiled brood & warm hug: She broods her eggs by shivering (they hatch twice as fast). Bonded, she is the best bed partner in the mod: Resistance I and Regeneration I on waking.
journal.monstergirls.cobra_lamia.signatu: Hood & snake charming: The hood display is a warning: back off and nothing happens; come closer and she spits venom (Blindness and Poison). A jukebox within 16 blocks keeps her calm, and a bonded cobra sways to it (the existing music system).
journal.monstergirls.sea_snake_lamia.sig: Reef guide & breath sharing: In a boat or swimming, a bonded sea snake leads you towards the nearest shipwreck or ocean ruin. Swimming beside her you have Water Breathing.
journal.monstergirls.rattlesnake_lamia.s: Fair warning & heat sight: Three stages like the ostrich: rattle, rattle louder and coil, then strike (Poison II). At night a bonded rattlesnake marks warm mobs within 20 blocks with Glowing for her player.
journal.monstergirls.boa_lamia.signature: Tree ambush & easy bond: She hangs from leaves and logs and drops onto mobs walking below. Affection gifts count double with her.
journal.monstergirls.naga_lamia.signatur: Guardian: Nobody she is not fond of opens a treasure chest (an unopened structure chest) within 10 blocks of her: she spreads her hood and warns them off. Your own chests are never hers to guard.
journal.monstergirls.wadjet_lamia.signat: Blessing: Every player who passes within 8 blocks, and the girls following them, gets Regeneration and Resistance. She hunts every hostile mob in sight. Name her Nekhbet and the blessing and her bite grow stronger.
journal.monstergirls.medusa_lamia.signat: Petrifying gaze: Look a stranger medusa in the eyes and you are slowed nearly to a stop; monsters that meet her gaze freeze for a few seconds. Befriended, she wears a blindfold so it is safe to look at her.
journal.monstergirls.tsuchinoko_lamia.si: Rolling: Downhill she curls up and rolls, faster than you can run. Her rare presents are golden.
journal.monstergirls.caraviper_lamia.sig: Spitting cobra: Befriended, she spits venom at the monsters near her friend: they are blinded and poisoned.
journal.monstergirls.jumping_spider_arac: Leap & shiny things: She leaps up to eight blocks to a target (a safety line means no fall damage). She follows any player holding gold, diamonds or emeralds, head tilting, and bonds fastest of the family.
Hunting web and phantom net: Wild, she strings cobwebs round the spot she settled on and goes for whatever they catch (players included) until fed meat. Bonded, she spins a web at night by your bed instead; phantoms, bats and vexes are caught in it. It fades at dawn.
journal.monstergirls.tarantula_arachne.s: Itchy hairs & moulting: Attackers get a face full of hairs (Nausea and Slowness). Every few days she moults and leaves an Exoskeleton (it works like Shed Skin). Petting builds affection twice as fast.
journal.monstergirls.trapdoor_spider_ara: Burrow ambush: She digs a hole in soft ground, sinks into it out of sight and bursts out at anything that comes within three blocks. Wild, that includes you, until she is fed meat. Calm, only monsters.
journal.monstergirls.wolf_spider_arachne: Carries her young & eyeshine: Her spiderlings ride on her back for their first day. Her eyes glow (a glow mask). Bonded, she runs ahead of you and hunts down hostile mobs first.
journal.monstergirls.jorogumo_arachne.si: Binding web: At night, a monster that comes within 8 blocks of her friend is caught in a cobweb at its feet. The web melts away after 10 seconds.
journal.monstergirls.horse_centaur.signa: Gallop: Ridden, she is the fastest mount in the mod (faster than a vanilla horse, slower than an ostrich sprint). Her lead mare leads the whole herd to safety.
journal.monstergirls.zebra_centaur.signa: Dazzle & alarm bark: When the herd runs, hostile mobs lose track of them (they drop their target). A bonded zebra guards your home: she barks an alarm (a loud call) when hostile mobs come within 16 blocks.
journal.monstergirls.reindeer_centaur.si: Snow trekker: No slowdown on snow or powder snow, for her or her rider. She digs moss, glow lichen and sweet berries out of snow and brings them as presents.
journal.monstergirls.goat_centaur.signat: Cliff climbing & head butt: She jumps two blocks high and never takes fall damage; ridden, so does her rider. Rude players (and hostile mobs) get rammed, like a vanilla goat but harder.
journal.monstergirls.alpaca_centaur.sign: Spit, fleece & pack: She spits at whoever annoys her (like a llama). Devoted, she carries a chest. Her fleece grows long and can be sheared (wool in her colour) without hurting her bond.
journal.monstergirls.tapir_centaur.signa: Baku: Phantoms never spawn for a player sleeping within 32 blocks of a tapir, and the phantom girl stays away too. She eats the bad dreams.
journal.monstergirls.camel_centaur.signa: Caravan: Anyone may ride her, friend or stranger. Feed her cactus beside a vanilla camel fed cactus and the two raise a calf. A bucket milks her (once every five minutes).
journal.monstergirls.dromedary_centaur.s: Caravan: Anyone may ride her, friend or stranger. Feed her cactus beside a vanilla camel fed cactus and the two raise a calf. A bucket milks her (once every five minutes).
journal.monstergirls.kelpie_centaur.sign: Water horse: Saddled, she carries you over water faster than any boat, and on land like a horse. By day she is calm. At night she attacks any player she is not fond of.
journal.monstergirls.pegasus_centaur.sig: Winged: Ridden, she leaps high into the air (hold jump) and glides down slowly. No true flight.
journal.monstergirls.unicorn_centaur.sig: Pure heart, healing horn: A player who has killed villagers or iron golems can never befriend her, and she keeps away from them. Her horn clears poison and wither from friends near her and speeds up the cure of zombie villagers. Friends may ride her.
journal.monstergirls.tusktaur_centaur.si: Tusk sweep: A sweep of her tusks knocks back everything in front of her. Friends ride her, and she never sinks in powder snow or freezes.
journal.monstergirls.aurorantler_centaur: Aurora antlers: Her antlers glow at night and light the snow around her. Her friend sees in the dark beside her (Night Vision).
journal.monstergirls.sphinx_centaur.sign: Riddles: She asks each newcomer a riddle; answer by handing her the item it means. A right answer earns a reward, a wrong one a pounce.
journal.monstergirls.momoshika_centaur.s: Peach blossom: By day her friend regenerates beside her; now and then her present is a golden apple.
journal.monstergirls.prairhorn_centaur.s: Swift: The fastest ride there is: friends ride her faster than any horse can gallop.
journal.monstergirls.halberelk_centaur.s: Woodcutter: Befriended, when her friend chops a log of a tree within 8 blocks of her, she fells the whole tree (crouch to cut one log).
journal.monstergirls.bellmare_centaur.si: Bellwether: Befriended, the cows, sheep, goats and pigs within 12 blocks follow her while she follows her friend.
journal.monstergirls.vicunero_centaur.si: Spitter: She spits at the monsters near her friend, like a llama. Friends can ride her.
journal.monstergirls.stagel_centaur.sign: Springing step: Befriended, her friend near her jumps high (Jump Boost II).
journal.monstergirls.lamassu_centaur.sig: Gate guardian: Befriended, her friend near her shrugs off blows (Resistance I).
journal.monstergirls.orca_mermaid.signat: Pod, teasing & protector: Orcas play with everything: they nudge swimmers, bump squid and fish up out of the water and laugh about it. A bonded orca and her pod defend you from drowned and guardians.
journal.monstergirls.koi_mermaid.signatu: Good fortune & waterfall climb: A bonded koi in a pond within 32 blocks of you gives Luck (better fishing and loot). She swims up water columns. Ten days at full devotion turns her into a dragon koi (a golden glow mask and longer fins).
journal.monstergirls.shark_mermaid.signa: Attacks anything: A wild shark attacks anything that swims near her: fish, squid, drowned, swimmers. Fed fish or meat once, she leaves you alone; more food and she warms up to you. Even a bonded shark hunts every fish and monster in the water.
journal.monstergirls.seal_mermaid.signat: Beach lounger & fisher: She moves on land at half speed (the best of the family) and never dries out on a beach. A bonded seal catches fish and brings them to you.
journal.monstergirls.axolotl_mermaid.sig: Regeneration & playing dead: Hurt, she plays dead and heals fast. After she fights beside you, you get Regeneration (like a vanilla axolotl). She can live on land for a long time if it is damp.
journal.monstergirls.dolphin_mermaid.sig: Teasing & leaping: She nudges swimmers and boats, steals a playful bump at squid and fish, then laughs and darts away. A bonded dolphin gives you Dolphin's Grace when she swims beside you.
journal.monstergirls.dugong_mermaid.sign: Sea cow: Almost always found in pairs. Seagrass wins her over, and friends get sea treasure.
journal.monstergirls.ahuizotl_mermaid.si: Fish thief: A wild ahuizotl steals fish off your fishing line with the hand on her tail. A lantern in your hand keeps her away. Befriended, she fishes for you instead.
journal.monstergirls.siren_mermaid.signa: Luring song: Her song draws strangers toward the water. Sung for a friend, it gives Conduit Power while they swim.
journal.monstergirls.axolume_mermaid.sig: Glow: She lights the water around her, and her friend heals beside her (Regeneration).
journal.monstergirls.mantarrow_mermaid.s: Manta ride: A friend can ride her across the water, faster than a boat; now and then she leaps clear of the waves.
journal.monstergirls.platypus_mermaid.si: Electrosense: Underwater she senses every monster within 16 blocks of her friend and makes them glow. Strangers who hit her are poisoned by her spur.
journal.monstergirls.moonseal_mermaid.si: Moon song: Her crescents glow at night; on a full moon she sings, and her friend near her regenerates. Befriended, she gives Dolphin's Grace to her friend swimming beside her.
Copper: Befriended, she scrapes the green off weathered copper blocks near her friend, one stage at a time. She dives up raw copper and nuggets as presents.
journal.monstergirls.reeffin_mermaid.sig: Reef keeper: Underwater she grows coral, coral fans and sea pickles on the sand around her.
journal.monstergirls.sword_koi_mermaid.s: Duellist: Befriended, she hunts the drowned near her friend, and a drowned she defeats always drops what it held (a trident, a nautilus shell, a fishing rod).
journal.monstergirls.sawfin_mermaid.sign: Undersea sapper: Befriended, her friend underwater near her digs fast (Haste II).
journal.monstergirls.verdant_slime.signa: Garden jelly: Crops and saplings within 4 blocks of where she rests grow faster (a bone meal tick every half minute). Devoted, she follows you and fertilises as she goes.
journal.monstergirls.magma_slime.signatu: Living furnace: Hand her raw food and she gives it back cooked (one item every few seconds). She glows (light) and sets nothing on fire unless angry.
journal.monstergirls.honey_slime.signatu: Sticky & beloved by bees: Mobs that touch her get Slowness. Bees never sting her bonded player while she is near. Hand her a glass bottle and she fills it with honey (once an hour).
journal.monstergirls.frost_slime.signatu: Chill: Water under her freezes (frost walker). Bonded, she puts out a burning player she touches and gives Fire Resistance for ten seconds (once a minute).
journal.monstergirls.amethyst_slime.sign: Resonance: She glows and chimes faster the nearer she is to ore (iron, gold, diamond, emerald within 8 blocks): an ore finder. Devoted, she brings amethyst shards and an occasional quartz or diamond.
journal.monstergirls.mixed_slime.signatu: Two in one: One slime carrying both girls, their bonds and their belongings. Never lost: hurt badly, she comes apart into the two again.
journal.monstergirls.mimic_slime.signatu: Treasure chest: One unopened loot chest in eight is a mimic: she bites once and keeps the loot. Gold wins her over; then she follows you and her loot is yours (crouch and right-click to open her).
journal.monstergirls.ender_slime.signatu: Teleporting: She teleports away when hit, like an enderman, picks up loose blocks and puts them down somewhere else. Endermites are her kin.
journal.monstergirls.undine_slime.signat: Living water: Befriended, she keeps the farmland near her watered, fills the cauldrons near her, and gives her friend Water Breathing in the water.
journal.monstergirls.klabuster_slime.sig: Manure: Befriended, every half minute the crops near her friend grow a stage, as if given bone meal.
journal.monstergirls.inaba_jackalope.sig: Moon-blessed: Spawns only at night under a full moon. Once a player has caught her (any right-click), all her affection gains are doubled. She glows faintly in moonlight.
journal.monstergirls.jack_jackalope.sign: Antler charge: She charges whatever hurts her (or her player), knocking it back hard. Her antlers fall off every few days and can be collected (a bone-like trophy).
journal.monstergirls.easter_jackalope.si: Hidden eggs: Every few minutes she hides a painted egg block nearby. Breaking one gives a small treat (cookies, dyes, gold nuggets, now and then an emerald).
Clan defence: Hurt one and every Al-mi'raj within 24 blocks attacks you. Her horn hits hard. A devoted Al-mi'raj defends you the same way.
journal.monstergirls.volcano_jackalope.s: Shy and tires easily: She bolts from anyone not crouching, but runs out of breath after a few seconds and has to stop and pant. Immune to fire and lava.
journal.monstergirls.wolpertinger_jackal: Prankster: She double-jumps and glides down from heights on little wings. Now and then she swaps your boots for leather ones; feed her to get yours back.
journal.monstergirls.clockhare_jackalope: Pocket watch: Her watch chimes at dawn and at dusk, and warns her friend when phantoms are due. Her friend works faster beside her (Haste).
journal.monstergirls.boghare_jackalope.s: Leaps: She leaps huge distances; her friend near her gets Jump Boost. Frogs are her kin.
journal.monstergirls.cattle_minotaur.sig: The best milk: She can be milked twice as often at high friendship, and brings milk and wheat as presents.
journal.monstergirls.minoan_minotaur.sig: Labyrinth guard: She claims the spot where she spawned and charges strangers who come within ten blocks (after a warning bellow). Devoted, she guards your home instead.
journal.monstergirls.bison_minotaur.sign: Stampede: When one panics the whole herd runs, trampling what is in the way. She never freezes in powder snow.
journal.monstergirls.aurochs_minotaur.si: Unstoppable charge: Her charge breaks through leaves and fences and knocks back anything, even an iron golem. Knockback does not move her.
journal.monstergirls.water_buffalo_minot: Mud wallow: She spends the hot hours in water or on mud, and swims well. Her milk makes the richest cheese (a present: a milk bucket and a cake now and then).
journal.monstergirls.sheep_minotaur.sign: Wool: Shears take her wool (it regrows after she grazes). Dye her like a sheep and her wool takes the colour. Vanilla sheep follow her as their shepherd.
journal.monstergirls.highland_minotaur.s: Never cold: Her shaggy coat keeps out any cold: she never freezes, and walks on powder snow.
journal.monstergirls.yak_minotaur.signat: Pack yak: Give her a chest and she carries two rows of cargo (crouch and use her to open it), following you over the mountains. She never freezes either.
journal.monstergirls.rhiwool_minotaur.si: Rhino charge: She charges in a straight line and sends whatever she hits flying. Shears take her wool, which grows back once she grazes.
Plough: Led on a lead, she ploughs as she walks: the grass and dirt she passes over turns to farmland.
journal.monstergirls.mooskuh_minotaur.si: Moss: The stone she rests on slowly grows into moss. You can milk her with a bucket.
journal.monstergirls.reedbull_minotaur.s: Reed planter: Befriended, every half minute she plants sugar cane on bare sand or dirt beside the water near her friend.
Dust bath: Befriended, when her friend near her catches fire she rolls them in the dust: the fire goes out and they are fireproof for a few seconds.
journal.monstergirls.kraken_mollusk.sign: Grip: Her grab holds a target in place while she squeezes. A wild kraken attacks swimmers in the deep until she is fed fish.
journal.monstergirls.ika_mollusk.signatu: Hair lash: Her tentacle hair hits anything within four blocks. Hurt, she squirts ink and dashes away.
journal.monstergirls.octopus_mollusk.sig: Opens doors, ink: She opens doors, trapdoors and fence gates. Startled, she squirts ink (Blindness) and runs.
journal.monstergirls.snail_mollusk.signa: Shell retreat: Anything sudden and she pulls into her shell (80% less damage, no movement) for a while. She is tamed with vegetables, not fish.
journal.monstergirls.ammonite_mollusk.si: Retract: Threatened, she pulls her whole body into her shell (80% less damage). She gives fossils (bones, nautilus shells) as presents.
journal.monstergirls.jellyfish_mollusk.s: Sting and glow: She glows at night and stings whatever bumps into her (Poison). Friends are never stung, and swimming near her they see in the dark (Night Vision).
journal.monstergirls.squidkin_mollusk.si: Ink cloud: Befriended, when her friend is hurt near her, she squirts ink: the monsters around go blind and her friend turns invisible for a moment.
journal.monstergirls.night_elf.signature: Night trader: She only roams at night and trades moonlit goods: glowstone, ender pearls, amethyst, night vision potions, phantom membrane.
journal.monstergirls.high_elf.signature: Settlement builder: Her group builds an elven pavilion (quartz, birch and lanterns) block by block. Strangers inside it are warned, then attacked.
journal.monstergirls.wood_elf.signature: Village guardian: Spawns only near villages. She shoots raiders and zombies that threaten villagers, and trades arrows, saplings and honey.
journal.monstergirls.blood_elf.signature: Fireproof trader: Immune to fire and lava. She trades Nether goods for gold, and her blade sets enemies alight.
journal.monstergirls.desert_elf.signatur: Gunslinger: Spawns only near desert villages. Quick on the draw with a crossbow, she guards the town and trades leather, crossbows and cactus goods.
journal.monstergirls.dark_elf.signature: Warden's kin: She walks silently and never sets off sculk sensors or shriekers. While she likes you, a Warden near her lets you be. Her gifts are echo shards and sculk.
journal.monstergirls.brownie_elf.signatu: Chores: At night she tidies the chests near her friend's bed (merging stacks) and gathers loose items lying nearby into a chest.
journal.monstergirls.valkyrie_elf.signat: Chooser of the slain: Befriended, when her friend dies within 32 blocks of her, she gathers everything they drop and gives it back when they come within 6 blocks of her again.
Moves when unseen: She creeps after her chosen player only while not being looked at, and freezes when watched. Reaching you, she tugs at your sleeve (a small push) until fed.
Fire and light: She floats, glows (a real light) and is fireproof; whatever hits her catches fire. At night she leads the player she likes towards buried treasure or a shipwreck.
journal.monstergirls.yuki_onna_undead.si: Freezing touch: She creeps after a player while unseen. Her touch freezes like powder snow. Only in snowy biomes; she melts away (despawns) anywhere warm.
journal.monstergirls.phantom_undead.sign: Insomnia: Spawns above players who have not slept for three nights (like a vanilla phantom) and swoops at them. Befriended, she keeps the vanilla phantoms away.
journal.monstergirls.vampire_undead.sign: Bedside visits: While you sleep she may appear and drink: you wake with two hearts less and Weakness, never killed. A polite one asks first. Sunlight slows her.
journal.monstergirls.zombie_undead.signa: Bite, then friendship: Hostile at first. Rotten flesh calms her (and only rotten flesh); then it builds friendship. She never burns in daylight, but gets lazy in it.
journal.monstergirls.frankenstein_undead: Very shy: She flees anyone not crouching. Struck by lightning she is healed and stronger for a day. Devoted, she is a terrifying bodyguard.
journal.monstergirls.banshee_undead.sign: Keening: When a player within 24 blocks drops to three hearts or fewer, she keens. Every hostile mob within 16 blocks of that player glows for ten seconds, as a bell shows raiders. She keens at most once a minute for each player.
journal.monstergirls.dullahan_undead.sig: Headless rider: She often rides a skeleton horse through the night. Anyone holding gold makes her back away.
journal.monstergirls.lich_undead.signatu: Phylactery: She casts slowness and weakness. While her phylactery stands she cannot die: she reforms beside it. Break it and she is peaceful. Befriended, she trades experience for books.
journal.monstergirls.llorona_undead.sign: Bringing them home: At night she finds lost young animals and village children and leads them home to their own kind. Bring one home with her and she stops weeping for the night.
journal.monstergirls.mummy_undead.signat: Unravelling: Hits loosen her bandages (string and paper). Befriended, a crouching pull with an empty hand unravels her a layer at a time, down to skimpy wraps; then she hurries, spins and wraps herself up again.
journal.monstergirls.yurei_undead.signat: Haunting: At night, befriended, she haunts the monsters near her friend: they grow weak (Weakness I).
journal.monstergirls.salamander_lizardfo: Fire tail: Fireproof, swims in lava, glows. Her hits set things alight.
journal.monstergirls.chameleon_lizardfol: Vanishing: Invisible while standing still. Her long tongue snatches dropped items (and insects) from four blocks away.
journal.monstergirls.iguana_lizardfolk.s: Speed: The fastest of the family: she outruns a sprinting player and swims well. She bobs her head at rivals.
journal.monstergirls.croc_lizardfolk.sig: Death roll: Hostile at first. In water she grabs prey and rolls: held fast and badly hurt. Fed meat, she calms; fed more, she is fiercely loyal.
journal.monstergirls.turtle_lizardfolk.s: Shell retreat: Hurt, she pulls into her shell (80% less damage). She swims fast and lays her eggs on her home beach.
journal.monstergirls.snapping_turtle_liz: Tongue lure: While she sits still in water she catches a fish now and then and drops it at her feet (cod or salmon, at most three lying around at a time). Hit her and she hides in her shell. Her bite is the hardest in the family after the crocodile's.
journal.monstergirls.kappa_lizardfolk.si: Her dish: Wet (water, rain) she is strong. Two minutes dry and her dish has run empty: she is weak and slow. Bow to her and she bows back, spilling it: a kappa who was after you stops at once.
journal.monstergirls.black_tortoise_liza: Shell: Arrows glance off her shell. The north of the Four Symbols.
journal.monstergirls.red_eared_slider_li: Sliding off: Sliders bask together by the water. When a stranger comes within 6 blocks, every slider nearby slides into the nearest water at once. Every food is worth double to her.
journal.monstergirls.galapagos_tortoise_: A ride on her shell: The slowest girl there is, and the toughest. A friend can sit on her shell: she keeps going where she was going. Cactus does not prick her.
journal.monstergirls.box_turtle_lizardfo: Shut tight: Hidden in her shell she takes no damage at all. A stranger sprinting near her makes her shut. She never strays more than 16 blocks from home.
journal.monstergirls.softshell_turtle_li: Buried: Still on a sandy, muddy or gravel riverbed she is buried out of sight and breathes underwater. A stranger who comes within a block and a half gets bitten. No armour, but quick on land and in water.
journal.monstergirls.matamata_lizardfolk: Leaf litter: Still in the water she looks like dead leaves (invisible). Fish that swim within 4 blocks are sucked into her mouth; her friend gets the fish.
journal.monstergirls.gecko_lizardfolk.si: Climber: Fast, and she climbs walls. Curious: she trails you and goes to look at anything you drop. She sheds her tail when hit, and it grows back.
journal.monstergirls.chupacabra_lizardfo: Goat hunter: She hunts wild goats only, never tamed, named, leashed or fenced ones, and hides when you look straight at her. Fed, she lingers near you but takes no orders; at high friendship she leaves mutton.
journal.monstergirls.anvil_tortoise_liza: Anvil shell: Hand her a damaged tool or armour piece with one of its repair materials and she mends it, for no experience. Too heavy to push or knock back.
journal.monstergirls.cocoskink_lizardfol: Cocoa: Befriended, she grows cocoa pods on the jungle logs near her friend.
Lifeguard: Befriended, if her friend runs out of air near her, she hauls them up to the surface and their air fills back up.
journal.monstergirls.iron_kobold_lizardf: Smith: Hand her a damaged iron or chainmail tool or piece of armour and she mends a quarter of it, for one iron ingot from your pack.
journal.monstergirls.conch_turtle_lizard: Conch call: Befriended, her friend underwater near her has Conduit Power: they breathe, see and dig as if beside a conduit.
journal.monstergirls.long_dragon.signatu: Rain bringer: She flies slowly and ominously in high circles. A devoted long dragon can bring rain to dry farmland (once a day).
Coil: Her coils hold anything she grabs (Slowness IV) and crush it. Arrows barely hurt her.
journal.monstergirls.wyrm_dragon.signatu: Fire breath: She flies and breathes fire at enemies. At full devotion she lets you ride her through the sky.
journal.monstergirls.gryphon_dragon.sign: Rideable flyer: At high friendship she carries you and flies (jump to climb).
journal.monstergirls.kannae_dragon.signa: Lightning: Once in a while she calls lightning on an enemy. She clings to her favourite player and naps on their head (sits on their shoulder area).
journal.monstergirls.wyvern_dragon.signa: Poison sting: She dives from the sky and stings (Poison II). Her wings make her the fastest flyer.
journal.monstergirls.orochi_dragon.signa: Seven heads: Each attack bites every enemy around her. A honey bottle makes her drowsy for a minute (no attacks) and +3.
journal.monstergirls.alebrije_dragon.sig: Colours: She flies. Befriended, now and then she dyes a sheep near her in a bright colour, and her presents are dyes.
journal.monstergirls.cockatrice_dragon.s: Stony glare: Befriended, every 3 seconds she glares at a monster near her friend and it is slowed almost to a stop.
journal.monstergirls.lesser_devil.signat: Pranks: She steals an item from your hotbar, swaps two slots or shoves you, then flutters off laughing. Feed her and she gives it back.
journal.monstergirls.succubus_devil.sign: Charm & bed visits: Her gaze slows the player she is after. At night she shares your bed whatever her affection, and is always expecting by morning.
journal.monstergirls.greater_devil.signa: Hellfire: Fireproof, flies, and throws fireballs when angered. Devoted, she scorches your enemies.
journal.monstergirls.jack_o_lantern_devi: Pumpkin disguise: Standing still she looks like a carved pumpkin. She creeps after players while they look away, and glows at night.
journal.monstergirls.jiang_shi_devil.sig: Hopping: She moves only in hops, attacks at night, and a paper talisman calms her. By day she sleeps standing up.
journal.monstergirls.oni_devil.signature: Iron club: Big and hard-hitting. Thrown beans (cocoa beans) drive her away, as at Setsubun. Befriended, she guards your door at night.
journal.monstergirls.gremlin_devil.signa: Tinkering: At night a wild one pranks what people built: she flips levers and opens doors. A cookie stops her. Befriended, she tinkers with furnaces near her friend so they cook twice as fast.
journal.monstergirls.karakasa_obake_devi: Umbrella: Befriended, her umbrella catches the arrows and other projectiles aimed at her friend near her.
journal.monstergirls.chochin_obake_devil: Lantern: Her lantern glows. Befriended, at night she keeps beside her friend and lights the way where they go.
journal.monstergirls.ittan_momen_devil.s: Flying cloth: She flies. Befriended, her friend climbs on with an empty hand and rides her through the air, steering where they look.
journal.monstergirls.rokurokubi_devil.si: Night watch: After dark her neck rises high, and the monsters within 24 blocks of her friend glow.
journal.monstergirls.kikimora_devil.sign: Night latch: At night, befriended, she shuts the wooden doors, trapdoors and fence gates left open near her friend.
journal.monstergirls.mosquito_bug.signat: Drinks blood: Hostile: drains blood (damage plus Hunger, Weakness or Poison). Calmed with honey, she drains hostile mobs for you instead.
journal.monstergirls.moth_bug.signature: Drawn to light: At night she flies to the brightest light within 16 blocks and circles it. Devoted, she gives Night Vision.
journal.monstergirls.moth_larva_bug.sign: Metamorphosis: She crawls, eats grass, leaves and dropped food, and after five days spins a cocoon and emerges as a moth.
journal.monstergirls.fairy_bug.signature: Healing and fountains: She heals hurt players near her (Regeneration) and slowly builds a fairy fountain: a pool ringed with flowers. Its water heals.
journal.monstergirls.fairy_queen_bug.sig: Blessings: Rises from a finished fountain. She grants positive effects (Regeneration, Strength, Speed, Luck) to those she favours.
journal.monstergirls.scorpion_bug.signat: Sting and brood: Her tail stings (Poison II). Her young ride on her back for a day after they are born.
journal.monstergirls.bee_bug.signature: Pollinator: She visits flowers, makes crops grow and fills the nearest beehive with honey. Hurt the hive and she stings.
journal.monstergirls.queen_bee_bug.signa: Hive keeper's friend: Every beehive a player places near her is worth +5. Bees near her work twice as fast.
journal.monstergirls.papillon_bug.signat: Flowers: She gathers around flowers and plants new ones where she rests.
Metamorphosis: She crawls and eats, and after five days becomes a papillon.
journal.monstergirls.hornet_bug.signatur: Territorial: She stings players who come too close and hunts bees and bee girls until someone befriends her. On patrol she tears into hostile mobs. Friends get paper and clay.
journal.monstergirls.firefly_bug.signatu: Blinking: She glows at night, and the fireflies around her blink in time. A glass bottle catches her (or a fairy) in a jar, a light block; break it to let her out.
journal.monstergirls.mantis_bug.signatur: Ambush: She holds a still prayer pose, then strikes in a flash at silverfish, endermites and spiders. The orchid mantis cannot be seen among flowers.
journal.monstergirls.scarabronze_bug.sig: The roller: Hand her rotten flesh and she rolls it into bone meal. At sunrise her friend gets Haste for the morning. Her shell is armour.
journal.monstergirls.temple_mantis_bug.s: Trapbreaker: Befriended, she cuts the tripwires of old temples and other structures within 8 blocks of her friend before anyone can trip them. Wires a player strung up are left alone.
journal.monstergirls.date_beetle_bug.sig: Date share: Befriended, when her friend near her is hungry she shares a date with them (three hunger points).
journal.monstergirls.alraune_flora.signa: Pollen: Attackers are dusted with pollen (Nausea and Slowness). She barely moves, and flowers spring up around her.
journal.monstergirls.matango_flora.signa: Mycelium travel: She sinks into mycelium or podzol and rises again nearby. Her spores make attackers sick (Nausea, Poison).
journal.monstergirls.ent_flora.signature: Planter: She plants saplings as she walks and hits extremely hard. Axes and fire anger her.
journal.monstergirls.cactus_flora.signat: Thorns: Anything that hits her is hurt by her spines. She blooms when happy (a flower present).
journal.monstergirls.mandragora_flora.si: Scream: She hides in the ground with only her leaves showing. Pulled out, she screams: mobs nearby (not you) are stunned (Slowness IV, Nausea).
journal.monstergirls.leshy_flora.signatu: Forest lord: He counts the logs you cut and the saplings you plant near him. Planters get saplings and apples; clear-cutters get lost in his fog. Meeting a vodyanoy, he bellows at him.
journal.monstergirls.venus_flytrap_flora: Snap trap: Rooted like the alraune. Her trap snaps shut on any mob or stranger that steps into reach, holding and biting. Befriended, she only snaps at monsters: a garden guard.
journal.monstergirls.kesaran_pasaran_flo: On the wind: She never touches the ground: the wind carries her along, all of them drifting the same way; befriended, she drifts after her friend and brings them Luck. Fed sugar, she splits in two (up to three of her).
journal.monstergirls.dryad_flora.signatu: Tree mother: Befriended, every half minute the saplings near her friend grow as if given bone meal.
journal.monstergirls.wolf_canid.signatur: Pack hunter: Wild, her pack hunts sheep and rabbits. Befriended, your tamed wolves join her fights. She howls at night.
journal.monstergirls.polar_bear_canid.si: Ice hunter: Wild, she hunts seal mermaids and penguin harpies. She fishes at open water, and attacks anyone near her cubs.
journal.monstergirls.panda_canid.signatu: Personality: Lazy (lies about), worried (fears strangers and storms), playful (rolls), aggressive (hits back hard, guards her friends), weak (sneezes often) or normal. She sneezes up slimeballs now and then.
journal.monstergirls.anubis_canid.signat: The weighing: She weighs every player who comes near. Anyone who killed villagers or iron golems is condemned and hunted. Others may open the tomb chests she guards.
journal.monstergirls.kobold_canid.signat: Nose for ore: Befriended, she sniffs out the nearest diamond, gold or emerald ore and points the way. She yelps when the block you look at holds up sand or gravel, and she smells mimics: a mimic chest near her rattles.
journal.monstergirls.grizzly_canid.signa: Forager: She fishes salmon from rivers, raids full beehives for honey (the bees sting her for it) and hibernates while it snows.
journal.monstergirls.black_bear_canid.si: Scares easily: She climbs trees and eats berry bushes bare. A sprinting stranger, an explosion, a bell or a goat horn sends her running, dropping what she holds; befriended, only explosions still do.
journal.monstergirls.meloncollie_canid.s: Herding: Befriended, she rounds up stray cows, sheep, pigs and chickens and herds them back to the nearest fenced pen. She plants melon seeds.
journal.monstergirls.cu_sith_canid.signa: Three barks: When monsters come near her friend she barks; at her third bark they flee.
journal.monstergirls.yeti_canid.signatur: Snowballs: She throws snowballs at the monsters near her friend, and now and then builds a snow golem. She walks on powder snow and never freezes.
journal.monstergirls.amarok_canid.signat: Pack mother: Befriended, her friend's tamed wolves near her fight harder (Strength I).
journal.monstergirls.capybara_rodent.sig: Calm: No wolf, fox, cat or ocelot hunts within 8 blocks of her. Idle girls nearby sit down beside her. She soaks in water with a yuzu on her head.
journal.monstergirls.ratatoskr_rodent.si: Messenger: She carries an item you give her to the nearest other player she is fond of (now and then she swaps it for something else). She hoards seeds and saplings, and the ones she forgets grow into trees.
journal.monstergirls.needlehog_rodent.si: Quills: Frightened, she rolls into a ball of quills that pricks whatever touches her. She hunts silverfish and picks up paper and books she finds.
journal.monstergirls.coatimano_rodent.si: Digger: She sniffs out suspicious sand and gravel within 12 blocks and brushes it out; befriended, she brings you what she finds.
journal.monstergirls.marmotaur_rodent.si: Lookout: When monsters come within 16 blocks of her friend she whistles a warning and they glow. She headbutts hard.
journal.monstergirls.bambadger_rodent.si: Flute: Befriended, every half minute she plays her flute, and the bamboo and sugar cane around her grow.
journal.monstergirls.squirricerat_rodent: Horns and acorns: She charges horns-first at monsters. She buries saplings, which grow into trees.
journal.monstergirls.kamaitachi_rodent.s: Whirlwind: She is fast. Befriended, her gusts cut the tall grass, leaves and cobwebs around her friend. Her slashes knock back.
journal.monstergirls.silkcoon_rodent.sig: Washer: By water, hand her dyed wool, carpet, a bed, terracotta, glass or leather armour and she washes the dye out.
journal.monstergirls.rockhyrax_rodent.si: Sentinel: Befriended, she whistles when a creeper comes within 12 blocks of her friend, and the creeper glows.
journal.monstergirls.crab_crustacean.sig: Pinch: Neutral: she pinches whoever hits her first (Slowness). The decorator variant dresses her shell in kelp and coral, like the spider crab's relatives.
journal.monstergirls.hermit_crab_crustac: Shell swap: Give her a nautilus shell or a shulker shell and she moves in; you get her old one back. She pinches whoever hits her first.
journal.monstergirls.floodcrab_crustacea: Puddler: Befriended, every 20 seconds she turns a block of dirt beside the water near her into mud.
Pouch and kick: Her joey rides in her pouch until it is grown. She fights with kicks that knock back hard. The outback variant wears a red hoodie and sunglasses.
journal.monstergirls.koala_marsupial.sig: Asleep: Awake only at dawn and dusk; the rest of the time she sleeps clinging to a tree trunk. Her joey rides on her back. The rare drop bear drops onto whoever walks under her tree (a hug, once she likes you).
journal.monstergirls.gliderune_marsupial: Glider: She glides down from any height. Befriended, she rides on your shoulder and you fall slowly while she is there (Slow Falling).
Roll up: A hit or a sprinting stranger rolls her into a ball: she takes no damage. Befriended, she rolls into monsters near her friend. The ranger variant wears a cowboy hat and scarf, a rolling frontier guard.
journal.monstergirls.aegis_boar_armoured: Shield: Befriended, she takes a third of every hit meant for her friend within 8 blocks, and charges what struck them.
journal.monstergirls.slothren_armoured.s: Mossy: She hangs from branches by day and barely moves. Moss and flowers spread around where she rests; befriended, crops and saplings near her grow as if bone-mealed.
journal.monstergirls.gribboar_armoured.s: Truffle hunter: Every half minute she roots in the dirt she stands on and digs something up: mushrooms, potatoes, carrots, now and then a gold nugget.
journal.monstergirls.riverdillo_armoured: Angler: In the water near her friend she catches fish and brings them: cod and salmon, now and then a tropical fish.
journal.monstergirls.golem_construct.sig: Village guardian: 120 health, more than an iron golem. She fights monsters near villagers, and iron golems follow her. When she falls she breaks into pieces.
Stone by day: By day she turns to stone: nothing hurts her. At night she wakes, flies, and fights monsters near her friend.
journal.monstergirls.talosling_construct: Clockwork: Redstone dust winds her spring (five minutes a dust, up to twenty): while wound she guards her friend; run down, she sits still until wound again.
journal.monstergirls.tin_squirrel_constr: Scrap: Hand her a worn-out iron or gold tool or armour piece and she breaks it down into nuggets. She picks up nuggets lying near her.
journal.monstergirls.cave_bat.signature: Roost and ping: She hangs upside down from ceilings to rest. Befriended, she pings every few seconds and monsters near her friend glow for a moment, through walls. The fruit bat has a fox face.
journal.monstergirls.date_bat.signature: Pollinator: She roosts by day. At night she flies from flower to flower, and the crops near her friend grow.
journal.monstergirls.frond_bat.signature: Leaf shaker: Befriended, every half minute she shakes the leaves near her friend: saplings, sticks and apples fall.
journal.monstergirls.title: Harmontide Journal
journal.monstergirls.empty: No one yet. Go and meet someone!
message.monstergirls.expedition_set_off: %s sets off with your map. She'll be back in a day
message.monstergirls.expedition_back: %s is back from her expedition, and brought you something!
journal.monstergirls.guide.friends.title: Making friends
journal.monstergirls.guide.friends: Feed her what she likes and pat her with an empty hand. At 10 friendship she is your friend: her gift of a behaviour starts, and a stick gives her orders (sneak for her stance).
journal.monstergirls.guide.hearth.title: A hearth
journal.monstergirls.guide.hearth: A campfire ringed by eight stone bricks. Your friends roaming free within 16 blocks settle there; a day later each builds a hut nearby. With three or more, every morning they leave presents in the hearth.
journal.monstergirls.guide.expedition: Give a grown friend an empty map: she sets off and comes back a day later with finds of her homeland, and now and then a new friend.
journal.monstergirls.guide.weapons.title: Weapons
journal.monstergirls.guide.weapons: The girls who fight for you take a bow, crossbow or gun: hand it over or throw it near her, and ammunition too. Sneak with an empty hand to take it back.
journal.monstergirls.bastet_nekomata.sig: Home guardian: Befriended, creepers will not hunt her friend near her: they lose interest and slink away.
journal.monstergirls.urchskin_lamia.sign: Urchin spines: Befriended, monsters that hurt her friend near her are pricked by her spines in return.
journal.monstergirls.spoodr_arachne.sign: Web sweeper: Befriended, every few seconds she clears a cobweb near her friend and keeps the string for them.
journal.monstergirls.ushi_oni_arachne.si: Bellow: Befriended, when monsters come near her friend she bellows: they flee, slowed.
journal.monstergirls.palmyr_centaur.sign: Fleet foot: Befriended, her friend near her runs faster while sprinting (Speed I).
journal.monstergirls.rusalka_mermaid.sig: River's luck: Befriended, her friend fishing near her has the Luck of the Sea.
Ram charge: Befriended, she charges creepers that come near her friend and knocks them away before they blow.
journal.monstergirls.domovoi_elf.signatu: Hearth keeper: Befriended, the lit furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces near her friend smelt faster.
journal.monstergirls.turtfolk_lizardfolk: Shell guard: Befriended, every half minute she shields her friend near her: two hearts of absorption.
journal.monstergirls.tarnhelm_canid.sign: Sentinel: Befriended, raiders and illagers within 48 blocks of her friend glow through walls.
journal.monstergirls.pineskrell_rodent.s: Ore sense: Befriended, every few seconds the ores near her friend sparkle.
